$comment: Machine-readable project context for Claude. Read this FIRST in a new chat — it replaces re-exploring the codebase. Keep it updated when architecture changes. Secrets are NEVER stored here; see `secrets_location`.

project.name: Store Shift
project.what_it_is: Embedded Shopify app that migrates a merchant's WooCommerce store data into their Shopify store.
project.status: Deployed to production. Not yet published on the Shopify App Store (unlisted).

golden_rules: Migrations NEVER run inside an HTTP request — always queued jobs.
Everything is chunked: WooCommerce paginated, Shopify batched.
Every migrator is idempotent via the migration_items mapping table.
Respect Shopify rate limits (429 / THROTTLED) with exponential backoff.
Database is the source of truth; the frontend polls, never holds migration state.
All credentials encrypted at rest, never returned to the client (masked).
Multi-tenant: every query scoped by shop_id.

tech_stack.frontend: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Shopify Polaris + App Bridge
tech_stack.queue: database driver (shared hosting has no Redis); Redis+Horizon recommended for scale

folder_structure.note: The repo mirrors the production layout exactly. `app/` is the deployable web root.

local.store-shift/index.html: Public landing page (plain HTML/CSS, no build step). Contains an embed guard: if opened with host/embedded/billing params it redirects to /app/, so the marketing page can never render inside the Shopify admin iframe.
local.store-shift/site.css: Shared stylesheet for ALL public pages (landing, legal, docs, contact)
local.store-shift/privacy|terms|refund|contact: Public pages served at clean URLs via directory index — no .htaccess rewrite needed, so /app is never affected. privacy/ is the URL Shopify requires for the listing.
local.store-shift/app/index.php: PRODUCTION front controller — paths point to ./backend/ (NOT ../)
local.store-shift/app/backend/public/index.php: LOCAL dev front controller — paths use ../ (for php artisan serve)
local.store-shift/app/backend/resources/spa/in: Built SPA shell, served by Laravel (NOT in public/)
local.store-shift/app/backend-htaccess.txt: Deny-all htaccess — rename to backend/.htaccess on the server

two_surfaces.merchant_app: Embedded in Shopify admin at /app/. Auth = Shopify session token (JWT).
two_surfaces.super_admin: Separate SPA section at /app/admin. Auth = own bearer token. No Shopify involvement.

routing.spa_catchall: backend/routes/web.php serves resources/spa/index.html for any non-/api path
routing.install_prompt: If no shop context (no ?host, no ?shop, no stored shop) the app shows InstallPrompt instead of the dashboard

migration_engine.base_class: AbstractMigrator — template method enforcing idempotency for every migrator
migration_engine.registry: MigratorRegistry — resolves + topologically orders entities by dependency
migration_engine.job_graph: StartMigrationJob (plans counts + batches) -> ProcessBatchJob per page, each SELF-ADVANCING to the next via MigrationRunner::advance() -> FinalizeMigrationJob. NOT a Bus chain any more: a chain died at the first failed batch and froze the whole migration.
migration_engine.resilience: Batches are resumable (migration_batches.processed_offset) and time-bounded (35s, then re-dispatch a fresh job). Counters are DERIVED from migration_items by MigrationRunner::syncCounters(), never incremented, so a replayed batch cannot inflate progress. `php artisan migration:watchdog` (cron every 5 min) resumes anything that stalled.
migration_engine.field_shedding: ShedsRejectedFields trait (replaces the old SurvivesMediaFailures/SurvivesFieldRejections). On a userError the migrator drops the OPTIONAL field Shopify complained about and retries, up to 3 rounds, then records the record with a warning naming what was left behind. Required fields are never shed and a MIXED error set still fails the item, so real problems stay visible. Per-migrator optional lists: product = files/metafields/collections/tags/vendor/productType/descriptionHtml; category = image/descriptionHtml; customer = phone/addresses/tags; order = transactions/shippingAddress/billingAddress/shippingLines/tags/note/processedAt.
migration_engine.media_short_circuit: After 5 products have their images rejected in one run, ProductMigrator stops sending images entirely for that migration (cache flag migration:{id}:media_unreachable) — halves the Shopify calls on a store whose /uploads is gone, and logs a warning explaining it.
migration_engine.upsert: ProductMigrator and CategoryMigrator upsert (update existing, recreate if deleted in Shopify). Others skip if already successful.

ACTIVE.ProductMigrator: Uses Shopify productSet. Migrates title, description, vendor, productType, status, tags, prices, compareAtPrice, SKU, inventory + tracking, weight (+unit), requiresShipping, variants + options, product AND variant images, metafields, brands, collection links. Variants/images are INLINE here.
ACTIVE.CategoryMigrator: Woo categories -> Shopify collections (incl. category image). Upserts.
ACTIVE.CustomerMigrator: Profile + addresses + custom tags. NO passwords (hash incompatible).
ACTIVE.OrderMigrator: orderCreate: line items, shipping lines, addresses, financial status, historical processedAt, transactions, tags.

NO_OP_KEPT_FOR_COMPAT.AttributeMigrator: Does nothing — options come from ProductMigrator
NO_OP_KEPT_FOR_COMPAT.ProductVariationMigrator: Does nothing — variants are inline in ProductMigrator
NO_OP_KEPT_FOR_COMPAT.MediaMigrator: Does nothing — images are inline in ProductMigrator
NO_OP_KEPT_FOR_COMPAT.why: These were removed from the wizard UI because selecting them created no-op jobs and inflated estimates. Registry still accepts them so old migrations don't break.

services.ShopifyClient: GraphQL client. Handles 429/THROTTLED, normalizes `errors` (Shopify sometimes returns a STRING not an array), sends variables as object not array, refreshes token before each call.
services.ShopifyOAuth: Shop-domain validation, HMAC verification (OAuth + webhooks), authorize URL, scope diffing (write_X implies read_X).
services.ShopifyTokenService: EXPIRING offline tokens: token exchange (expiring=1), legacy permanent-token migration, refresh_token flow, ensureFresh().
services.SessionToken: Verifies App Bridge JWT (HS256, aud/dest/exp/nbf) with 60s clock-skew leeway.
services.ShopifyWebhookRegistrar: Reconciles webhook subscriptions via GraphQL — UPDATES stale callback URLs instead of duplicating.
services.ShopifyBilling: appSubscriptionCreate, confirmation URL, activate on callback, cancel. Free plans recorded locally without touching Shopify.
services.WooCommerceClient: REST v3 wrapper. Retries only transient failures (never 4xx). X-WP-Total for counts.

database_tables.shops: shopify_domain, access_token(enc), refresh_token(enc), token_expires_at, refresh_token_expires_at, scopes, installed_at, uninstalled_at
database_tables.woocommerce_connections: store_url, consumer_key(enc), consumer_secret(enc), status, wc_version, wp_version
database_tables.store_migrations: NOTE: named store_migrations (NOT migrations — that's Laravel's own table). name, status, selected_entities(json), options(json: custom_tags, default_vendor, weight_unit)
database_tables.migration_items: IDEMPOTENCY MAPPING. unique(shop_id, entity_type, woocommerce_id) -> shopify_id
database_tables.plans: code, name, price, interval, limits(json), active
database_tables.dashboard_contents: admin-managed content shown in the merchant app
database_tables.app_settings: admin-editable app config. One ENCRYPTED json blob per key: 'mail' = SMTP (overrides .env at boot via MailSettings::apply()), 'branding' = email logo + name (App\Services\Branding). The logo file lives in storage/app/branding and is streamed by the public GET /api/branding/logo route, so no storage:link is needed.

plans_and_limits.source_of_truth: plans table (DB), editable from /app/admin/plans — no deploy needed

limit_semantics.0: feature not included in the plan

plans_and_limits.enforcement: StartMigrationJob caps each entity total to the plan limit and writes a warning to migration_logs. Shop::limitFor() maps entity -> limit key.
plans_and_limits.fallback: A shop with no active subscription automatically gets the 'starter' plan.

plan_gating.ui: NewMigration wizard disables and un-ticks locked/exhausted entities, shows the reason in a banner with a 'View plans' CTA, and the summary shows migratable-of-total

semantics.locked: limit === 0 — the plan does not include the entity at all
semantics.exhausted: cap spent AND more source records exist than the cap will ever reach (a fully-migrated store inside the cap is NOT exhausted — re-running refreshes it)
semantics.capped: count > limit — still selectable, migrates the first `limit`

plan_gating.enforcement: POST /api/migrations returns 422 for locked entities; StartMigrationJob caps totals; ProcessBatchJob slices each page to the remaining allowance

merchant.token_type: EXPIRING offline token (expiring=1). Permanent offline tokens are deprecated by Shopify.
merchant.dev_fallback: X-Shop-Domain header, only in local/testing env
merchant.middleware: shopify.session -> AuthenticateSessionToken (also auto-exchanges the session token for a fresh offline token)

admin.token: random 64 chars, only sha256 hash stored

known_gotchas.issue: PowerShell Compress-Archive writes BACKSLASHES into zip entries
known_gotchas.fix: Build zips with Python zipfile using forward slashes (build-prod.bat does this)

known_gotchas.issue: Two different index.php files with the same name
known_gotchas.symptom: 500 on every route: 'Failed to open stream: .../vendor/autoload.php'
known_gotchas.fix: app/index.php uses ./backend/ paths (production). app/backend/public/index.php uses ../ (local dev). NEVER copy one over the other.
rm bootstrap/cache/*.php then php artisan config:cache route:cache
php artisan config:cache after ANY .env edit
Cron every minute: cd ~/public_html/app/backend && php artisan queue:work --stop-when-empty --max-time=55

known_gotchas.issue: Polaris `url:` props ignore the router basename
known_gotchas.fix: AppProvider linkComponent routes all internal Polaris links through React Router (main.tsx)
60s leeway via SHOPIFY_TOKEN_LEEWAY; also sync the system clock

known_gotchas.issue: Shopify returns `errors` as a STRING sometimes
known_gotchas.symptom: foreach() argument must be of type array|object, string given

known_gotchas.cause: Subscription registered against an old app URL; REST create returns 422 and was ignored
known_gotchas.fix: ShopifyWebhookRegistrar reconciles via GraphQL. Run: php artisan shopify:sync-webhooks

known_gotchas.issue: Queue worker caches PHP code in memory
known_gotchas.fix: Restart the worker after ANY backend code change

known_gotchas.issue: retry_after shorter than a batch => the SAME job runs twice
known_gotchas.symptom: Progress far ahead of reality (100/112 processed but only 24 collections), failed count = failures x attempts, then the migration freezes at 'processing' with no error and later entities never start
known_gotchas.cause: config/queue.php retry_after was 90s; a 100-item batch takes longer, so the queue re-reserved it and ran a second copy. Retries ran out -> Bus chain died.
known_gotchas.fix: retry_after now 900s; batches are resumable + time-bounded; ProcessBatchJob self-advances instead of chaining; counters derived from migration_items. Run migration:watchdog to recover an already-stuck run.

known_gotchas.issue: Shopify fills the catalogue with 'Import placeholder for {sku}' draft products
known_gotchas.symptom: After an order migration the merchant's Products list is hundreds of empty drafts named after numeric SKUs
known_gotchas.cause: OrderMigrator sent `sku` on each line item. Shopify treats it as a PRODUCT REFERENCE and auto-creates a draft placeholder when it matches no existing variant.
known_gotchas.fix: Never send `sku` on order line items — OrderMigrator::lineTitle() appends it to the title instead, so the information survives without triggering product creation. Cleanup for an affected store: search 'Import placeholder' in Shopify Products and bulk delete.

known_gotchas.issue: Orders fail in bursts with 'Too many attempts. Please try again later.'
known_gotchas.symptom: Exactly ~5 orders succeed per attempt, every remaining order is marked failed. Repeats identically on every retry.
known_gotchas.cause: Shopify rate limits orderCreate SEPARATELY from the GraphQL cost budget and reports it as a plain userError — not a 429, not a THROTTLED code — so it was recorded as a permanent item failure.
known_gotchas.fix: ShopifyClient::looksRateLimited() scans the response for these messages and throws ShopifyThrottledException, so the batch pauses 60s and resumes instead of burning the records.

known_gotchas.cause: The 35s time budget is only checked BETWEEN items; one heavy product (variations fetch + productSet + media retry) can exceed Laravel's 60s default job timeout.
known_gotchas.fix: ProcessBatchJob and RetryFailedItemsJob set $timeout = 300 — above any single record, below retry_after (900).

known_gotchas.issue: Progress bar full while most records failed
known_gotchas.symptom: '50/50 · 20 ok · 30 failed' drew a 100% bar, reading as success
known_gotchas.fix: MigrationDetails draws successful/total (what actually landed) with a critical tone when failed > 0

known_gotchas.issue: WooCommerce phone numbers are rejected by Shopify
known_gotchas.cause: Woo stores whatever the shopper typed ('0300 1234567'); Shopify wants E.164
known_gotchas.fix: App\Support\PhoneNumber::toE164() uses the billing COUNTRY to supply the calling code and strips the national trunk zero (Italy keeps it). If Shopify still rejects it, SurvivesFieldRejections drops the phone and keeps the customer, with a warning. Also covers 'Phone has already been taken'.

known_gotchas.issue: A dead image URL failed the whole product/collection
known_gotchas.symptom: Store with a deleted /uploads folder migrates nothing — every item errors with 'Image upload failed ... file not found'
known_gotchas.fix: SurvivesMediaFailures trait retries once without media and records a warning; the record still lands

known_gotchas.issue: Re-running a migration created nothing (all skipped)
known_gotchas.cause: Mapping said 'already migrated' but products were deleted in Shopify
known_gotchas.fix: Products/categories now upsert and self-heal (recreate if the Shopify object is gone)

known_gotchas.issue: SSL cert failure on Windows dev (cURL error 60)
known_gotchas.fix: curl.cainfo + openssl.cafile set in php.ini to a cacert.pem

blockers_to_going_live.impact: Customers AND Orders both fail with ACCESS_DENIED until approved
blockers_to_going_live.where: Partner Dashboard -> app -> Distribution (set first) -> API access requests -> Protected customer data

blockers_to_going_live.impact: Source and vendor readable on the internet
No migration ever progresses without it
Merchants are never actually charged while true

Legal entity on all public pages is 'Webnday Pvt. Ltd', with Store Shift as its product. No registered address or named jurisdiction is published — governing law refers to the jurisdiction in which Webnday Pvt. Ltd is registered.
Every public page and the App Store listing points at it; the reviewer may email it

blockers_to_going_live.item: Public WooCommerce test store for the reviewer
blockers_to_going_live.impact: Reviewer cannot test the app; common rejection reason

high_value_ideas: Migration preview / dry-run (show what WILL happen before starting) — highest trust win
Incremental / delta sync (only migrate what changed) — payload_hash column already exists; justifies subscription
Rollback / undo a migration (mapping table has every Shopify ID)
smaller_gaps: Order line items are custom lines, not linked to migrated product variants
Some dashboard_contents types have no display surface (useful_link, email_info, other_resource)

commands.local_dev_all: start-dev.bat (backend :8000, queue worker, vite :5173, cloudflared tunnel)
commands.production_build: build-prod.bat  (builds frontend, copies SPA shell + assets, makes store-shift-deploy.zip)
commands.resume_stalled_migrations: php artisan migration:watchdog [--stall=10]  (cron every 5 min in production)

suites.MigrationEngineTest: queue dispatch, dependency ordering, idempotency, custom tags
suites.MigrationResilienceTest: a failed batch still advances the run; replaying a batch doesn't inflate counters; resume honours processed_offset; dead image URLs still create the record; the plan cap holds per item, not just at planning
suites.PlanLimitsTest: 10-product plan really caps at 10; upgrading lifts it; admin limit change applies immediately
suites.ShopifyOAuthTest: HMAC verification, encrypted token storage, bad HMAC rejected
suites.WebhookRegistrarTest: stale callback URL is updated, not duplicated
suites.FieldSheddingTest: each migrator drops the rejected optional field and survives; several bad fields shed in turn; required-field and mixed-error rejections still fail; media short-circuit stops the wasted retry
suites.PhoneNumberTest: E.164 across US/CA/GB/DE/FR/AU/AE/IN/PK, non-zero trunk prefixes (RU/KZ/LT 8, HU 06), extension stripping, and unusable input returning null
suites.MigrationNotificationTest: completion email sent only when asked; subject reflects the outcome; a dead SMTP server never undoes a finished migration
suites.MigrationVisibilityTest: entity rows exist at creation; counters written mid-batch; the merchant log endpoint is shop-scoped
suites.PlanGatingTest: preview carries the plan verdict per entity; spent allowance reads as exhausted; a fully-migrated store inside the cap does not; POST /api/migrations 422s a locked entity
suites.MailSettingsTest: admin auth required; password never returned; blob encrypted at rest; blank password keeps the stored one; stored settings override .env; no-op when unconfigured

secrets_location.note: NEVER store secrets in this file or in git.
secrets_location.smtp: NOT in .env any more (though .env still works as the fallback). Set it at /app/admin/settings — stored encrypted in app_settings and applied at boot.
